== Notes ==
* Generally used by [[sword]] and [[axe]] warriors in [[PvP]]. [[Hammer]] warriors tend to use [[Flail]] instead, partly due to their lower [[armor rating]] and partly because Flail has less of a drawback when foes are [[Knock down|knocked down]]. 
* [[Damage reduction]], such as [[Protective Spirit]], will be taken into account after Frenzy, therefore mitigating the additional damage.
** If not using skills such as Protective Spirit, the use of a [[cancel stance]], such as [[Rush]], is advisable.
* Frenzy is generally too risky to use on secondary warriors, as their lower armor rating combined with the Frenzy drawback makes them too vulnerable.
* It is the only stance available in pre-Searing.
